final: WITH c AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId AS PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS cnt FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS av FROM c) SELECT c.PlaylistId, c.cnt AS track_count, CASE WHEN a.av = 0 THEN NULL ELSE c.cnt * 1.0 / a.av END AS ratio FROM c, a ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
